run_submitit_finetune: run multinode MAE finetuning job on a SLURM cluster using submitit
run_Trainer_call: run the Trainer callable to setup GPU args and start classification finetuning
run_Trainer_checkpoint: run the Trainer checkpoint method to requeue a job with a delayed submission
run_parse_args: run parse_args to get SLURM and MAE finetune CLI arguments including ngpus and nodes
run_get_init_file: run get_init_file to create a unique init file URI for distributed training
